definitions.short: Anamim , a son of Mizraim and his descendants, with their country
definitions.full: H6047. Anamim עֲנָמִים proper name, of a people in (or near) Egypt Gen 10:13 = 1Chr 1:11 , Αινειαμιειμ , Αινεμετιειμ , etc.; form dubious and locality unknown, see conjectures in Di.
definitions.rootNote: as if plural of some Egyptian word;
